purpose: Non-admission discovery of independently versioned open-first global lightning climatology alternatives.

entries.name: WGLC 2019 PANGAEA global lightning climatology and monthly density
entries.resolution_or_granularity: 0.5 degree monthly NetCDF4, 108 months and 12 climatological bins
entries.note: Distinct immutable DOI release; not a licence for 2026 WGLC or raw WWLLN. PANGAEA landing page explicitly CC BY 4.0 and gives ZIP locator https://store.pangaea.de/Publications/KaplanJ-LauH_2019/WWLLN.zip. On 2026-11-25 bounded HTTPS GET on macOS downloaded 37038662 bytes, SHA-256 ef9ef83797f861c68930856ab4f57e392d575c79e7ca46bc7c2f8cf13e19f7d5. ZIP CRC check passed; two entries WWLLN_climatology.nc (5947906 bytes) and WWLLN_monthly.nc (31343698 bytes). HDF5 inspection of climatology verified lon 720, lat 360, time 12, lightning shape 12 x 360 x 720, units strokes km-2, CF-1.7 and source AE detection-efficiency corrected stroke counts. Calendar units days since 0000-01-01 00:00:00 require explicit CF calendar handling; monthly file not yet parsed. Stroke counts not optical flashes; monthly density cannot track storms. Open-first priority: complete exact archive reuse/API review, inspect monthly data/missingness/cell-area and compare to independent radar hail frequencies. No raw bytes in Git or Neon; not admitted. Subsequent same-day offline inspection of the retained original ZIP parsed the full monthly member (31343698 bytes, SHA-256 eb43bf169e7b3c7ec67bfb0a067e0e7a4475b2f84e503a05139e9a74bafbe694). Float32 lightning shape 108 x 360 x 720; coordinate centers lat -89.75 to 89.75, lon -179.75 to 179.75, strictly increasing. Time is strictly increasing from 0 to 3256 days since 2010-01-01, explicit 365_day calendar; do not interpret as Gregorian offsets. All 27993600 stored values finite and not fill (NaN), 20306788 zero, no negatives, range 0 to 14.3060941696167 strokes km-2; every month has 259200 finite cells. Numeric completeness is not detection coverage or physical no-lightning evidence. Provider variable long_name says flashes but units and documentation explicitly describe strokes. Retain stroke semantics; verify geographic/time detection bias and area weights before modelling. PANGAEA exact DOI still explicitly CC BY 4.0; platform terms https://www.pangaea.de/about/terms.php section 5.5 restrict mass retrieval and automated commercial web-page extraction absent authorization. Data reuse with attribution is distinct from automated access; no new live request authorized here.

entries.name: NASA LIS/OTD Reprocessed Flash Climatology
entries.provider: NASA GHRC DAAC / Cecil et al.
entries.temporal_scope: OTD April 1995-March 2000; TRMM LIS December 1997-April 2015; ISS LIS March 2017-November 2023, 27 sampled calendar years
entries.resolution_or_granularity: 0.1 degree gridded annual mean flash rate, annual/diurnal cycle and mission-specific time series
entries.note: NASA catalog https://catalog.data.gov/dataset/lis-otd-reprocessed-flash-climatology identifies US government works rights label and collection C3671144020-GHRC_DAAC; paper https://doi.org/10.1175/JAMC-D-25-0110.1. Live anonymous CMR granule query on 2026-11-25 returned COMB_OTD_TRMM_ISS_AnnualMean.hdf, COMB_OTD_TRMM_ISS_AnnualDiurnalCycle.hdf, COMB_OTD_TRMM_ISS_AnnualCycle.hdf and OTD monthly/annual files under https://data.ghrc.earthdata.nasa.gov/ghrcw-protected/lorfc__2/. Combined granules span 1995-04-13 to 2023-11-16; not continuous observing time. CMR reported granule_size 0, not evidence files are empty or free to acquire. Exact version, Earthdata account and HDF reader required; review mission-specific rights, detection efficiency, observation opportunity, time bins and units. No original payload downloaded. Use as frequency/diurnal context, not hail events.
